text.brief: Henry Kissinger feigned a stomach illness in Pakistan and flew in secret to Beijing on July 9, 1971.
text.record: The flight ran through the channel of Yahya Khan, Pakistan's military ruler, whose army had begun a crackdown in East Pakistan that March ([FRUS 1969-76, Vol. XVII, Document 139 (Kissinger-Zhou memorandum of conversation, July 9, 1971)](https://history.state.gov/historicaldocuments/frus1969-76v17/d139); [National Security Archive: Department of State's Dissent Channel revealed](https://nsarchive.gwu.edu/briefing-book/foia/2018-03-15/department-states-dissent-channel-revealed)). Kissinger spent about seventeen hours in talks with Zhou Enlai, and Nixon announced on July 15 that he would visit the People's Republic ([FRUS 1969-72, Vol. E-13, Document 9: Kissinger to Nixon, July 14, 1971](https://history.state.gov/historicaldocuments/frus1969-76ve13/d9); [Remarks to the Nation Announcing Acceptance of an Invitation to Visit the People's Republic of China, July 15, 1971 (American Presidency Project)](https://www.presidency.ucsb.edu/documents/remarks-the-nation-announcing-acceptance-invitation-visit-the-peoples-republic-china)). On April 6 the consul general in Dacca, Archer Blood, had cabled a formal dissent against American silence on the killings ([National Security Archive: Department of State's Dissent Channel revealed](https://nsarchive.gwu.edu/briefing-book/foia/2018-03-15/department-states-dissent-channel-revealed)). The State Department recalled Blood that June ([FRUS 1969-76 vol. XI: list of persons (Blood, Consul General in Dacca until June 1971)](https://history.state.gov/historicaldocuments/frus1969-76v11/persons); [FRUS 1969-76 vol. XI, doc. 20: Nixon-Kissinger telephone call, April 6, 1971, with editorial note on Blood's transfer](https://history.state.gov/historicaldocuments/frus1969-76v11/d20); [Foreign Service Journal, December 2004 (American Foreign Service Association; professional body)](https://afsa.org/sites/default/files/flipping_book/1204/63/)).
text.reading: Washington routed a strategic shift through one intermediary, and that intermediary's war then shaped American policy in South Asia for the rest of the year. Kissinger's illness was Stratagem 6 run by an American. The Party chose the channel and the timing, and secrecy kept Congress and the allies out of the terms until Nixon went on television.
text.gapText: Architecture Governance. No one outside the White House owned the terms of the opening, so a single channel set the price for the whole government.
text.fix: Brief the committees of jurisdiction in confidence before a secret channel commits the country, and keep the channel secret from everyone else.
